messages:
Amy (PM): quick sync — we're cutting a packaging change that adds a new 'Reserved Lite' SKU and tweaks quotas. Need to confirm metering hooks, billing event shapes, and any contract blockers before we freeze the API tomorrow. TL;DR: who owns what?
Raj (Eng): I can own the metering integration and the runtime tagging. ETA: prototype by EOD today, PR tomorrow morning. Need billing schema for events.
Linda (Billing): I'll own the billing mapping + invoice labels. Can you confirm what the meter id looks like? we prefer `meter.reserved_lite.tokens` or similar.
Raj (Eng): prefer `meter.reserved_lite.token_usage` — more explicit. We'll emit events: `{"meter":"meter.reserved_lite.token_usage","amount":INT,"timestamp":ISO}`. Will drop a JSON example in the PR.
Linda (Billing): perfect. Also: we need to ensure usage is aggregated to the customer's billing account id (account_id). send `account_id` and `region` in the payload.
Sarah (Legal): flag: any changes that affect committed spend or minimum term need to respect existing contracts. If Sales converts an existing Dedicated customer to Reserved Lite we must not auto-enroll them into a higher commit without signed amendment. Carlos, pls confirm whether Sales will contact impacted customers.
Carlos (Sales): We'll trigger outreach for customers in the 30-45 day target list. We'll add an opt-in flow. For renewals, we can add language but won't auto-convert — :+1: on legal constraint.
Amy (PM): Ownership summary for the release notes: Raj = metering + runtime tags; Linda = billing schema & invoice mapping; Sarah = contract constraints & copy review; Carlos = customer comms; Amy = rollout plan + console flags. Milestone: freeze API changes at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Raj (Eng): Quick question — do we need per-route quotas or global per-account? implementing per-route is heavier.
Linda (Billing): For pricing tiering we need per-account quotas. Route-level quotas are optional for the first pass; can be a new column later. Let's start with per-account quota enforcement.
Raj (Eng): ok per-account quotas. I'll implement server-side enforcement + counters emitted as `quota.remaining` events.
Amy (PM): can someone add the small example payload we discussed? would help Billing and Legal in docs.
Raj (Eng): pasted example:
```
{
  "meter": "meter.reserved_lite.token_usage",
  "amount": 1250,
  "account_id": "acct_01F2X3Z",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-06T18:12:03Z",
  "meta": { "model": "redwood-4k", "route": "/generate" }
}
```
Linda (Billing): looks good. one more: please include `plan_id` when available so we can map to billing tiers.
Raj (Eng): will add `plan_id` to the payload. also adding `quota_window` for enforcement.
Sarah (Legal): FYI — add a short note for the contract team: customers on legacy enterprise agreements get a 90-day notice before quota/price enforcement changes. I'll draft language.
Carlos (Sales): I'll prepare the outreach checklist. Amy, can you share the list of impacted accounts by noon?
Amy (PM): yes — pulling data now, will share CSV in the thread when ready. deploy-bot: any concerns on rollout schedule?
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for packaging-change branch at 2025-11-07T02:00:00Z UTC. Will notify #eng-releases when canary completes. :robot_face:
Raj (Eng): noted. I'll queue the PR and add the feature flag `reserved_lite_enabled` to the config.
Amy (PM): action items recap — Raj: PR + events + flags; Linda: mapping + invoice label; Sarah: contract language + review; Carlos: comms plan; Amy: CSV of impacted customers + rollout doc. If you can't hit these, raise now.
Linda (Billing): on track. filing a quick checklist in billing board.
Raj (Eng): small ask — who owns the acceptance test for billing events? I can add a unit test but prefer billing to sign off on event shape.
Linda (Billing): billing will sign off once we see events in staging. add a sample consumer test that asserts `meter`, `amount`, `account_id`, `plan_id`.
Amy (PM): thanks all. I'll post the final acceptance criteria later tonight. :white_check_mark:
